newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott plans to issue preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott plans to issue preferred stock.

text.p: Host Marriott Corp said Wednesday it intends to issue $400 million of convertible preferred securities.
Under the terms, the company may issue up to an additional $60 million of securities solely to cover over-allotments, if any, it said.
The proceeds are to be used to continue its program of acquiring hotels, for the refinancing of short-term debt and for other corporate purposes, Host Marriott said.
The company said it expects the offering to commence this week.
